newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products show firmer tone, some quiet.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products show firmer tone, some quiet.

text.p: Med oil products were showing a generally firmer tone, although trade in some was very thin, traders said on Wednesday.
Gasoline was heard subdued although firmer futures prices appeared to have boosted numbers.
A Turkish tender was announced for one 25,000 tonne low octane cargo for delivery in mid September, and one optional cargo for mid to late September. The tender is expected to close on Monday.
A trader's Skikda cargo loading in early September was thought likely to move to a Spanish refiner, but it was not known if a deal had been concluded.
Gas oil was firm with the market perking up as the holiday season comes to an end.
There was a fair amount of interest in low sulphur as the introduction of 0.05 percent sulphur on October 1 regulations draws closer. Premiums were put at $11 to $12 over 0.2 prices.
Russian material was seen strengthening. A cargo traded at quotes mean/mean +$2.0 for first half September on Tuesday, but traders said premiums had since strengthened to +$2.0/+$3.0.
An Italian Islands cargo traded at quotes fob Med +$3.50. Premiums were generally assessed at quotes fob Med +$3.25/+$3.75.

High sulphur cracked fuel oil remained hard to come by and prices were steady. The Portuguese tender, which is awarded on Friday, gave support but did not push prices above $93-94 fob. Most traders said deals if concluded would be done on a floating basis.
Low sulphur cracked cargoes were quiet with the main Med buyer again absent. Transatlantic offers were understood to have been around $113-114 cif Italy. -- London +44 171 542 8980
